## Summary
Allocates subscriber video streams across tracked downtracks based on bandwidth estimates, RTCP feedback, congestion state, track priority, and layer availability. It serializes allocation events, manages probing, and emits stream state updates when tracks become active or bandwidth-paused.

## Responsibilities
- Track video downtracks, priority, stream state, max subscribed layer, and allocation dirtiness.
- Consume REMB, transport-wide feedback, BWE congestion transitions, pacer probe events, and downtrack layer changes.
- Allocate one track or all tracks under stable, deficient, paused, and congestion conditions.
- Manage padding or media probing to discover extra capacity.
- Notify callers about active and paused stream state changes.

  - Handle REMB, transport-wide feedback, congestion, pacer probe, and stream allocator listener callbacks.

  - Emit stream state updates when tracks become active or bandwidth-paused.

- file: `track.go`

  summary: Wraps an SFU DownTrack with allocator-specific metadata, allocation forwarding methods, NACK delta tracking, and sorters used by stream allocation decisions.
  responsibilities:
